NPPA updates list of reduced MRP of 1,085 anti-cancer drugs

PTILast Updated: Nov 04, 2026, 04:06:00 PM IST

Synopsis

The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority updated the maximum retail price for 1,085 anti-cancer medicines. This revision follows a previous decrease of prices for 543 anti-cancer drugs announced on October 28. The updated list contains prices based on information submitted by pharmaceutical companies up to November 3. The NPPA will continuously update this list as more manufacturers submit revised prices.

Listen to this article in summarized format

New Delhi, Drug price regulator NPPA on Tuesday updated the revised maximum retail price list for 1,085 anti-cancer medicines of different brands, effective November 9.

The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) on October 28 revised downward the maximum retail price (MRP) of 543 anti-cancer medicines of different brands.

The total number of such drugs in the list currently stands at 1,085, according to a post on X by the NPPA.

The revised list reflects information submitted by pharmaceutical companies up to November 3, and will keep getting updated as and when manufacturers submit revised prices for non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs.

The price revision follows the NPPA's October 17 announcement enforcing trade margin rationalisation on 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs.
